verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party bulk-operation capability, such as multi-select batch edits, batch asset processing or bulk actions exposed through the CLI or MCP. What the evidence does show is building blocks: command-line automation, scripting APIs, editor extensions and `unity eval`, which a developer could use to construct bulk operations. Build Automation's simultaneous multi-platform builds belong to the CI/build story, not bulk operations across items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
